data.summary: Confirmed by the maintainer on 2026-10-01. Bounded implementation: src/host-canonical.ts (pure host logic), src/www-redirect.ts and src/outer-middleware.ts (sequence of the www redirect then the namespace guard, wired as EmDash's middleware.outer), astro.config.mjs cache provider cacheCloudflare(), src/page-cache.ts (pure cache policy: pages tag plus EmDash's cacheHint, maxAge 300, swr 60, Vary Host and Cookie) applied in ContentPage.astro for rendered pages only, unit tests, smoke checks, docs and proof/www-redirect-cache-20261001. Verification: unit tests, build and workerd smoke in the worktree, the full npm run verify at the same commit in a sibling path (the app worktree's dot-directory path breaks rolldown's tsconfig resolution for astro check only), CI on the PR; live proof after the separately gated deploy (cf-cache-status MISS then HIT, timings, www 301 after warming the apex, /_emdash still Access-gated), and a purge check if a publish happens. Deploy and merge stay separate gates.
